steps.title: Open the tape cockpit
steps.narration: This is Tapeology — a tape-reading cockpit for real US equities. Enter a symbol, pick a data source, and the cockpit streams every trade in real time.
steps.point_out: The watch form with symbol input, source selector, and Watch button — ready for input.

steps.title: Select Historical mode and pick a date
steps.narration: Switch to Historical mode and type in a date to replay a real past session tick-by-tick. Tapeology fetches the actual SIP trade-and-quote feed — no simulated data.
steps.point_out: The source selector now shows Historical, and the date input and time-window picker have appeared.

steps.title: Open the time-window picker
steps.narration: The time-window picker shows your local timezone and quick-pick buttons for common US market windows — Open 30, Last 1 hr, and more — so you never have to do mental timezone arithmetic.
steps.point_out: The timezone label (Europe/London) and quick-pick buttons like 'Open 30' and 'Last 1 hr' inside the picker.

steps.title: Watch AAPL historical — cockpit populates with real data
steps.narration: Type AAPL, choose a recent trading day, and hit Watch. Within 30 seconds the cockpit fills with real bid, ask, spread, and last-price figures pulled straight from the SIP consolidated tape.
steps.point_out: Live bid/ask/spread/last numbers in the quote panel, a tape-state reading (e.g. Bullish), and the candlestick chart starting to build from the first bars.

steps.title: Recent trades — every print has a side
steps.narration: Scroll down to the recent-trades list. Every single print is stamped Buy or Sell — none are left as Unknown. The trade-side classifier runs on the full SIP quote feed, resolving each trade against the prevailing bid and ask.
steps.point_out: The recent-trades list with Buy/Sell labels on every row and zero Unknown entries.

steps.title: Price chart shows real clock times, not elapsed seconds
steps.narration: The candlestick chart's time axis shows real market clock times — 09:30, 09:35 — anchored to the actual session open. Tape-state transition markers appear exactly where the engine detected a regime change.
steps.point_out: Human-readable time labels on the chart x-axis (09:30, 09:35, etc.) and coloured tape-state marker flags at regime-change points.

steps.title: Closed-market: honest panel instead of a spinner
steps.narration: Try watching AAPL in Live mode when the US market is closed. Instead of an infinite spinner or silence, the cockpit tells you exactly when the next session opens — down to the minute, in your local timezone.
steps.point_out: The 'market is currently closed' panel with the next-open date and time shown in your local timezone.

steps.title: Unknown symbol: clear rejection, no fabricated data
steps.narration: Enter a nonsense ticker and Tapeology says so plainly — it is not a tradable symbol — rather than hanging or silently returning an empty cockpit. The honesty-first design means every edge case surfaces a real explanation.
steps.point_out: The rejection panel with the plain-language message about the symbol not being tradable, and no cockpit panels populated.
